metadata.description: Root cause analysis plugin for production incident investigation

plugins.name: thufir
plugins.description: Root cause analysis plugin integrating Prometheus, GitHub, and GitLab for production incident investigation
plugins.longDescription: Thufir is a comprehensive root cause analysis plugin that transforms production incidents into actionable insights. It autonomously investigates alerts from Prometheus, issues from GitHub/GitLab, analyzes metrics, searches code, traces git history, and generates detailed RCA reports following industry best practices.
